claims.claim_text: The indexed Nelson B Paris is confirmed as the OSS Dawes Mission naval photographer.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Naval photographer Nelson B. Paris came along to record the historic mission.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official history names the rare full name and a naval photographic role consistent with the indexed rating.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact rare name plus a directly matching naval photographic role in an official institutional OSS history.
claims.temporal_assessment: The source establishes wartime OSS role, not the affiliation immediately before OSS service.
claims.match_notes: No pre-OSS employer or Navy transfer chronology is inferred from the mission account.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Evan J Parker Jr. is linked at high confidence to the archival interview of the OSS Jedburgh veteran.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The archival item supplies the same distinctive full name and suffix in an OSS context; Cornell's Class of 1941 record corroborates the identity.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare full name and suffix, direct OSS archival context, and independent Cornell record.
claims.temporal_assessment: The evidence establishes identity and prewar student status but not the immediate predecessor to OSS service.
claims.match_notes: The Cornell record is not used as employment evidence.

claims.claim_text: Evan J Parker Jr. was a member of Cornell University's Class of 1941.
claims.evidence_excerpt: 41 It's Our 45th ... Evan J Parker (Potomac, Md.)
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Cornell's institutional alumni magazine lists Evan J Parker in the Class of 1941 column.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive name, Cornell class record, and independent OSS archival interview with the same full name and suffix.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented prewar student affiliation; it is not established as immediate pre-OSS or as employment.
claims.match_notes: Relationship type is student. Cornell is not counted as an employer in analytics.
